name: 993 Turbo/GT2 intercooler bracket, titanium F1 concept (photo-informed topology)
description: Single curved arm with a socket eye at each end and an off-centre raised two-hole pad, the topology of the genuine 993 110 110 50 as seen in a seller photograph and consistent with the PET 107-45 fastener and rubber-mount stack. Sizes are fitted to the FVD 255 x 80 x 23 mm envelope or assumed; no interface is measured. Supersedes the F0 two-rail plate, whose topology had no evidence behind it.

classification.intended_use: CAD and DfAM study of the bracket topology; interfaces blocked until measured; no vehicle fitting authorized

sources.title: EOS Titanium Ti64 Grade 5 material data sheet
sources.notes: LPBF/DMLS process reference: anisotropy, machine parameters and heat treatment must be qualified. See SRC-EOS-TI64-GRADE5.

sources.title: TIMETAL 6-4 physical properties
sources.notes: Density, modulus, expansion and minimum yield of wrought sheet are used for screening only; they are not LPBF allowables. See SRC-TIMET-TI64-PHYSICAL-PROPERTIES.

material.grade: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 for screening; the photographed OEM part looks cast aluminium, so titanium is a material change, not a like-for-like copy
material.standard: ASTM F2924 or equivalent supplier specification to be contracted

post_processing: heat treatment qualified for the machine, parameters and orientation
HIP to be decided after fatigue analysis
machining of eye bores and pad holes once measured
deburring and radiusing of the eye and pad junctions
passivation and galvanic isolation after dimensional inspection
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and powder recycling
witness coupons in critical orientations with representative tensile and fatigue
dimensional inspection of datums, center distances, bores and envelope
CT of nodes and bosses, then dye penetrant inspection after machining
contracted roughness, porosity, alpha case and residual stresses
instrumented static, vibration and thermal tests before any fitting

titanium.heat_treatment: Indicative EOS cycle to be confirmed for the selected machine and parameters; no recipe is frozen
machined_surfaces: pad face and two pad holes (unmeasured)
inspection: CT of bosses and rail junctions
tensile and fatigue coupons representative of the orientation
titanium.galvanic_isolation: Electrically separate the titanium from the aluminum intercooler and the steel fasteners with bushings, washers, coating and sealing qualified after the actual materials are identified.

known_limits: Topology (curved arm, two end eyes, off-centre two-hole pad) is read from an unscaled seller photograph; no dimension is taken from it.
Eye chord and arm sagitta are fitted to the FVD 255 x 80 x 23 mm envelope of an aftermarket reinforced bracket, not to the OEM part.
Eye bores, heights, arm section, pad position, hole diameter and pitch are assumptions.
Interfaces IF-1 to IF-3 are blocked_unmeasured: mating parts, datums, hole spacing and the assignment of the PET 107-45 fastener stack are not established.
No load case is evidenced, so F1 carries no stress or deflection result.
The OEM part looks cast aluminium; a Ti-6Al-4V copy of this shape screens at about 233 g against 141 g in aluminium, so titanium is not a mass win here.
The STEP proves only a valid BREP inside the envelope; it must be neither manufactured for fitting nor installed.
